items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the education minimum qualifications for the Accountant position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Education must be from an accredited institution. One year of education is equal to 30 semester (45 quarter) units. Education used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. If using completion of quarter/semester units to meet minimum qualifications, it must be clearly stated in the Education section of the application. Missing documentation may result in the education not being counted. Options: I have a Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution in accounting, business with a concentration in accounting, or a related field. | I have a Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution in another discipline. | I have completed an Associate degree OR 60 semester (90 quarter) units of college course work from an accredited institution. | I have completed LESS THAN 60 semester (90 quarter) units of college course work from an accredited institution.
EDUCATION: Completion of a Bachelor's degree in accounting, business with a concentration in accounting, or a related field;
, a bachelor's degree in any discipline AND one additional year of qualifying experience;
EXPERIENCE: Two years of experience related to the duties of the position.

, satisfactory completion of 60 semester units of course work AND two additional years of qualifying experience. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
